subject: English
question_text: From your reading of the passage give some ideas on the way to ensure a country's development.
guide_solution: A country can be developed by educated persons. Without education a country cannot be developed. So it is to say that to develop a country education is a must.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 123 — Milestone College, Dhaka

subject: English
question_text: "The rate of literacy or illiteracy in a country determines whether it is rich or poor, developed or underdeveloped." Why is it said?
guide_solution: The rate of literacy or illiteracy in a country determines whether it is rich or poor, developed or underdeveloped' is said because the country's development depends on education.

subject: English
question_text: What is the main obstacle to the way of removing illiteracy?
guide_solution: The main obstacle to the way of removing illiteracy is the social responsibility of all the literate people to make some concerted efforts to remove illiteracy from the society.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 123 — Milestone College, Dhaka

subject: English
question_text: Describe the idea that "Illiteracy is a curse".
guide_solution: Illiteracy is the root cause of ignorance which frustrates all development efforts of the government and the community.

question_text: Do you support the attitude that illiteracy should be removed?
